name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Two-stage 5wCal rendering. First show the full 35-day calendar immediately with dates, weekends, today, grid, header and widgets but without holiday calculations. After that first frame is visible, calculate all 35 holiday flags together in one deferred batch; only after all 35 checks finish, redraw every affected holiday cell together and flip once. Keep V0.72 arithmetic day-number/OFFSET fix and the 400 ms double-tap window. Diagnostics show initial T/D/C, then holiday calculation H and one-batch update U.
